slot_scores.name: training_capacity_per_jet
slot_scores.evidence_quote: is the number of trained pilots produced in a given year equal to the number of fighter jets allocated to training that year (i.e., one pilot trained per training jet), or is there a different conversion rate between training jets and pilots?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked about the conversion rate between training jets and pilots, directly targeting the per-jet training capacity.

slot_scores.name: pilot_to_combat_jet_mapping
slot_scores.rationale: The agent never asked how many combat jets a trained pilot can operate or about the pilot-to-combat-jet relationship.

slot_scores.name: training_duration_and_start
slot_scores.evidence_quote: does that mean a jet allocated to training in year 1 produces 5 pilots in year 1 AND can also produce 5 pilots in year 2 (i.e., the same jet trains pilots in both years), or does a jet allocated to training in year 1 only produce pilots in year 1 and a separate allocation is needed for year 2?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent touched on the timing of pilot production across years but did not explicitly ask about the start year or total duration of the training program.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: Trained pilots are counted directly without needing to map them to combat jets; no pilot-to-combat-jet ratio was considered.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent never asked about the relationship between trained pilots and combat jets, so this mapping was silently assumed to be irrelevant or one-to-one.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The agent resolved the P0 slot (training capacity) and the P1 slot (training duration/start) before entering READY_TO_MODEL; the only unresolved slot is P2, which does not affect core correctness.

summary: The agent asked targeted questions that recovered the critical P0 training capacity and P1 training timing details, but missed the low-impact P2 pilot-to-combat-jet mapping. It stopped appropriately after resolving all P0/P1 slots.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
